pretreatments.description: Ethanolic organosolv pretreatment performed using 50% or 75% v/v ethanol solution, either with or without 1% w/w H2SO4 catalyst at temperatures of 120, 140, or 180 °C for 60 minutes.
Enzymatic hydrolysis using a mixture of Cellic CTec2 and Cellic HTec2 enzymes (ratio 1:9) at pH 4.8 and 45 ± 1 °C for 72 hours.
Anaerobic digestion of the residual solids and the supernatant (hydrolysate) obtained after enzymatic hydrolysis, incubated at 37 °C for 45 days.
Mechanical processing involving ball-milling of potato crop residues to homogenize particles with a size less than 1 mm.
Drying of the recovered solids obtained after pretreatment at 40 °C for 2 days, then stored at 4 °C.
Washing of the recovered solids with 120 mL of 50% v/v ethanol solution followed by rinsing with distilled water before drying.
Recovery and drying of the filtrate liquid obtained after pretreatment using a laboratory distillation apparatus.
